"""Evaluate predictor on WikiText-2 only (skip C4 to avoid slow streaming)."""
import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "src"))

import torch
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
from data_utils import get_eval_dataset
from predictor import PredictorWrapper
import importlib.util

def _best_attn_impl():
    if importlib.util.find_spec("flash_attn"):
        return "flash_attention_2"
    return "sdpa"

device = torch.device("cuda:0")
model_path = "/root/autodl-tmp/models/llama-3.1-8b"
ckpt_path = "/root/distill_sparse_swiglu/checkpoints/mvp_bce_s456/predictor_bce.pt"
sparsity_target = 0.5
seq_len = 2048

print(f"Loading model from {model_path} ...")
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
    model_path, torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
    attn_implementation=_best_attn_impl(), device_map={"": device}
)
model.eval()
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_path)

wrapper = PredictorWrapper(model, bottleneck_size=128)
print(f"Loading predictor from {ckpt_path} ...")
ckpt = torch.load(ckpt_path, map_location=device, weights_only=True)
wrapper.predictors.load_state_dict(ckpt["predictors"])
wrapper.predictors.to(device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
wrapper.predictors.eval()
wrapper.gumbel_mask.hard = True

print("Loading WikiText-2 ...")
wt2 = get_eval_dataset("wikitext2", tokenizer, seq_len)
print(f"  {len(wt2)} sequences")

# Import teal_global_masks and evaluate_perplexity from evaluate.py
from evaluate import teal_global_masks, evaluate_perplexity

print("Computing TEAL global masks ...")
calib_ids = torch.stack([wt2[i]["input_ids"] for i in range(min(4, len(wt2)))]).to(device)
global_masks = teal_global_masks(wrapper, calib_ids, sparsity_target)

print("\nPer-layer sparsity (TEAL):")
for idx in sorted(global_masks):
    sp = 1.0 - global_masks[idx].mean().item()
    print(f"  Layer {idx:2d}: {sp:.3f}")
total_n = sum(m.numel() for m in global_masks.values())
total_z = sum((m == 0).sum().item() for m in global_masks.values())
model_sparsity = total_z / total_n
print(f"  Model-level: {model_sparsity:.3f}")

print("\nDense baseline (WikiText-2) ...")
dense_ppl = evaluate_perplexity(model, wt2, device)
print(f"  Perplexity: {dense_ppl:.2f}")

print("Sparse (WikiText-2) ...")
wt2_ppl = evaluate_perplexity(model, wt2, device, global_masks)
print(f"  Perplexity: {wt2_ppl:.2f}")

ppl_increase = (wt2_ppl - dense_ppl) / dense_ppl * 100
print(f"\n=== Summary (sparsity={sparsity_target*100:.0f}%) ===")
print(f"WikiText-2: sparse {wt2_ppl:.2f} / dense {dense_ppl:.2f} / increase {ppl_increase:.1f}%")
print(f"Model-level sparsity: {model_sparsity:.3f}")
